comment: Annotations for the aunt_kg test's animation.  Event numbers are the trace's seq numbers

ranges.caption: Invert the "parent" paths to create the "child" subtrie
Every person's parents: graft the child subtrie, then restrict it to people
mother(p) = parents(p) ∩ female, as one meet_2 per person
sister(p) = (children of p's parents ∩ female) − p
aunt(p) = (children of p's grandparents − p's parents) ∩ female

aunt(jon): fill in each grandparent's children
